What Every Field Survey Covers

Our trained Texas surveyors follow standardized field verification protocols. We climb roofs up to 12/12 pitch, remove electrical panel dead-fronts, enter attics, and document every obstruction with millimeter precision.

Roof Geometry & Structural Integrity

Digital pitch gauge verification on all roof planes, azimuth degrees, rafter/truss dimensions (2x4, 2x6), on-center spacing (16" vs 24" O.C.), roofing material layer audit, and remaining shingle lifespan.

Electrical Main Service Panel (MSP) Audit

Interior dead-front removal to photograph busbar rating, main breaker ampacity (NEC 705.12 120% rule), spare breaker slots, utility meter rating, lever bypass, and Grounding Electrode Conductor (GEC) paths.

Battery & Energy Storage (NFPA 855)

3-foot setback verification from operable doors and windows, system controller/gateway wall mounting elevations, conduit run measurements, and backup subpanel critical load mapping.

Obstruction Mapping & Aerial Photogrammetry

X/Y offset coordinates for plumbing vents, attic turbines, skylights, chimneys, and tree overhangs. Optional FAA Part 107 drone orthomosaic maps for large estates and commercial roofs.

02 ENGINEERING DISCIPLINE

Permit-Ready CAD Designs & Plan Sets

Full-scope solar PV and energy storage drafting built to local Texas AHJ standards, utility interconnection guidelines, and National Electrical Code (NEC).

Complete Permit Submittal Engineering

Our drafting team converts raw survey dimensions, site photos, and equipment specifications into clean, code-compliant permit packages ready for direct submission to city building departments and utilities.

Architectural & Structural Roof Plan Sets

Optimized module array placement, IFC fire code setbacks (36" ridge/valley paths), roof attachment details, rafter span structural analysis, and ASCE 7-16/7-22 wind & snow load ratings.

Single-Line (SLD) & 3-Line Electrical Schematics

String sizing calculations, conductor wire gauge & conduit schedules, OCPD sizing, voltage drop calculations (<2%), NEC 690 Rapid Shutdown (RSD), and NEC 705.12 120% rule calculations.

Battery & Microgrid Storage Engineering

Whole-home and partial-home backup transfer switches (ATS/Gateway), smart load centers, emergency power off (EPO) disconnects, and NFPA 855 ventilation & spatial compliance details.

AHJ Submittal & Placard Warning Schedules

Custom contractor title blocks, city-specific code notes, full equipment spec cut sheets, NEC warning placard directories, and Professional Engineer (PE) structural/electrical stamp readiness.

GOT QUESTIONS?

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our field site surveys and CAD permit drafting services.

Can I order Site Surveys and CAD Designs separately?

Yes! You can order standalone Site Surveys if you have an in-house drafting team, or send us your existing survey data to draft standalone CAD Plan Sets. Alternatively, our bundled Survey + CAD package provides the fastest zero-touch turnaround from field inspection to permit filing.

What is the standard turnaround time for each service?

Site Surveys: Survey packages (photos, dimensional reports, SLD sheets) are compiled, QA-checked, and uploaded within 24 to 48 hours of field visit completion.
CAD Designs: Full permit plan sets are typically delivered within 24 to 48 hours of receiving verified site dimensions. Rush 24-hour turnaround options are also available.

What happens if an AHJ requests revisions on a CAD Plan Set?

We provide 100% free revision support on all CAD plan sets for any AHJ comments or jurisdiction-specific requests. Our engineering team modifies the drawings immediately to ensure your permit is approved without extra costs or delays.

Do your CAD drawings support Professional Engineer (PE) Stamps?

Yes. All CAD plan sets are drafted in full compliance with ASCE structural loads and NEC electrical standards, ready for immediate review and stamping by your licensed Texas Professional Engineer (PE), or we can coordinate PE structural and electrical stamps upon request.

What geographic areas do you cover for field site surveys?

Our field site survey network coordinates verified surveyors across all 254 Texas counties, including Houston, Dallas-Fort Worth, Austin, San Antonio, El Paso, Rio Grande Valley, Lubbock, Amarillo, and surrounding submarkets. CAD design services are available nationwide.
